title: File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available
body:
File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available, so workspace admins no longer need to turn on a preview. Upload files to a conversation and analyze them in natural language alongside your other data. For supported file types and limits, see [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file) and [Upload a file to a Genie Agent](/aws/en/genie-agents/file-upload).

File upload in Genie One isn't supported for users who have only [consumer access](/aws/en/ai-bi/consumers).
